newsitem.title: UK: Singapore to launch Dublin cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to launch Dublin cargo flights.

text.p: Singapore Airlines is launching a weekly Boeing 747-400 freighter service to Dublin, said the airline's UK cargo manager, Barry Gibson.
The new service, set to start on October 27, will fly Singapore, Dubai, Dublin, Copenhagen then return Dubai, Singapore.

Gibson told Reuters the service is a direct result of the hi-tech industry's two-way traffic in moving goods between south east Asia and Europe. Many hi-tech assembly plants and manufacturers are based in Ireland, he added.
Previously, Singapore Airlines, had been flying electronic goods into London and trucking them to Ireland, he added.
"Irish exporters will now have direct access to markets in south east Asia," he said.
The new Ireland service will be sold by Singapore Airlines UK staff. --Air Cargo Newsroom tel:+44 171 542 7706 fax:+44 171 542 5017
